[quote=greater_rostoria;60967933]Korrin was a rather advanced colony. Large amounts of Federation funds were spent into the space infrastructure of the colony as it was the focal point in Aktus sphere colonisation, and thus Korrin had the capacity for both large trade and military fleets. Korrin had dozens of space stations positioned outside the moon's Kartovsky Range, some of its dockyards and trade posts were built in deep space but importantly all of its space communications stations were built far away to prevent disruptions. This made Korrin an efficient colony, one which was able to respond quickly to any incoming vessels.

The Marquesse was first detected by a Comet-class corvette, which tracked and observed the ship during its voyage in deep space. As the ship approached Korrin's Kartovsky Range it was intercepted by two mobile suits, their engines managing to close the distance in little time, then the two proceeded to circle around the vessel inspecting it for any weapons or markings. Soon after, a Korrin destroyer approached the Marquesse, though its weapons were not targeting the ship and instead it seemed to escort the the Marquesse towards Korrin's surface.

As the ship began to decelerate, the mobile suits returned back to the destroyer, and smaller docking craft with bright lights appeared to help the Marquesse in its descent down to a dock. Soon after the calming message was received, a reply was sent back from one of the communications station.

[i]"We received your message. We understand, and welcome you. You have permission to dock at Hangar 43, in Sector 7, coordinates have been provided. You will be escorted and guided."[/i]

The Rosenmarkke ship was led towards a small city, towering skyscrapers rising over the barren world while large refineries spewed smog into space. A large visible rail network could be seen by Joseph, taking ores from the mines of the moon towards the large automated factories, while countless merchant ships made trips to and from the cargo yards. The docking craft guided the Marquesse towards a underground circular dock, which opened up and allowed the ship to land. Large grappling hooks locked onto the Marquesse and held it in place as a bridge was positioned outside the doors of the ship.[/quote]
 
Joseph took a weary look at the two officers who had entered the cabin as they nodded and ordered him to leave the cabin, walking behind him less like guards and more like they were leading a hostage. 

He would be handed a briefcase with the terms and papers for a deal and ordered to leave the ship without ceremony.

[quote=ardella;60964230][b][i]ERENE STARBOUND[/i][/b]

[spoiler=[b]MASTERING THE ART OF STATESMANSHIP I[/b]]
All official communications, treaties and accords, negotiations, and overall dialogue between the government and other related stately entities of the Combine of Eirian and her counterparts in the Confederation of Feyria, or Feyria, will be hereby classified as material of dossier Subject-Case Yale.

With Feyria's position as a backyard neighbor, given their stewardship of the Hyperborean moon of Agartha, as well as their existence as Spacenoid rather than Erenites, the discourse with the Feyrians would take a more courtly approach, with Eirian diplomats willing to make concessions to the Feyrians to establish strong, foundational relations. Furthermore, Feyria's history as a former colony now independent is one that Eirian strongly identifies with...  

[list][sub][b]COMBINE OF EIRIAN
OFFICE OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS
HYPERBOREA, OUTER BELT REGION

TO: PRESIDENT THORMOD TODENSKOLD AND AUTHORISED STAFF OF HIS CABINET
FROM: DIPLOMATIC CORPS OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS; MINISTER DR. SEON MANCAID
CLASSIFICATION: SECURED DIPLOMATIC TRANSMISSION
DATED 10 JANUARY 2168

SUBJECT: ESTABLISHING EIRIAN-FEYRIAN TREATY OF FRIENDSHIP; REQUESTING IMMEDIATE SIGNATURE OR AMENDMENT OF TERMS[/b]

To His Utmost Excellency, the most esteemed President of the Confederacy of Feyria, and his honored cabinet,

Before the introduction of the subject matter, the Ministry of Interplanetary Affairs, on behalf of the Six Republics and its peoples, would love to extend a genuine, heartfelt message of congratulations to the Confederacy for its bold choice to pursue independence from the Federation. As Eirian takes its first steps of fledgling sovereignty, we express our best wishes to you and your people for this achievement: as we in the Six Republics say, the Symphony of Freedom knows no bounds or barrier. Nevertheless, the Combine of Eirian seeks to sign a Treaty of Friendship with the Confederacy of Feyria, based on the following terms.  

[b]- The Parties confirm that, following constructive and substantive consultations, they have agreed to the formal establishment and progressive development of relations between the Combine of Eirian and the Confederacy of Feyria.
- The Parties henceforth reaffirm their mutual recognition of each other as legitimate governing authorities and their commitment to relations which are wholly founded on equality, reciprocity, mutual respect, and principles of peaceful coexistence and shared prosperity; therefore, both Parties shall emphasize their shared intention to conduct relations in good faith and full respect of each other's political independence, legal order, and internal proccesses.
- The Parties announce the immediate establishment of formal diplomatic relations, and in this regard, have agreed to the exchange of permanent representatives under the creation of a diplomatic mission, subject to internal processes: to this end, the Combine of Eirian offers the lease of an embassy building at the Galen Embassy Plaza in the capital of Valee, and consular departments within the otehr five Republics.
- The Parties agree to maintain regular, timely, and structured political dialogue at the appropriate levels, including through periodic consultation.
- Recognizing the importance of material cooperation: the Parties therefore express an intent to promote expanded economic and trade relations based on mutual benefit. To this end, they will explore practical measures to facilitate trade, encourage long-term investment, and identify opportunities for joint economic initiatives.
- In the interest of maintaining peace and stability through Ardagan, the Parties reiterate their commitment to non-aggression and building of confidence. The signing of this Treaty will therefore enact a non-aggression pact between the Parties, which is only nullified upon the occurrence of open hostilities or other stated reasons between the Parties.
- The Parties will henceforth agree that this Treaty of Friendship shall constitute a foundational framework for continued relations between the Parties. They express a shared intent to deepen and broaden cooperation over time through understanding, protocol, or agreements, as mutually agreed  
- Any differences arising in the course of the implementation of this Treaty of Friendship shall be addressed through dialogue and consultation in a constructive and cooperative spirit.[/b]  

Taking into consideration the proximity of our two nations, we personally believe [b]that expanding this treaty, of course, at the behest of your government, towards further cooperation socially, economically, and militarily would bring in great prosperity.[/b] Furthermore, taking into account your offer of a mutual trade agreement, [b]we will agree to the purchase of both tonnages of ice and water from Eirian, in exchange for some return in metals or manufactured goods. Per standard tariffs, Feyrian goods will be taxed at a 10%, which may be applied for a cut to a lower level of 8% and lastly to 5% if not lowered automatically through goodwill. [/b]

We await your response, and your honored signature,   

[b]AURIN BRENN[/b]
Interim Speaker of the Provisional Congress
Republic of Eirian, Hyperborea

[b]DR. SEONS MANCAID[/b]
Minister of Interplanetary Affairs[/sub][/list]

([nation]Feyria[/nation)
